parameters.name: RoutePrefix
parameters.description: IP prefix for which this route is advertised.

parameters.name: SourceRouterID
parameters.description: Router-id of the router that originated this route.

parameters.name: Neighbor
parameters.description: Reference to the {{object|#.InterfaceSetting.{i}.Neighbor}} entry for the neighbor that advertised this route.

parameters.name: ReceivedMetric
parameters.description: The metric with which this route was advertised by the neighbor, or maximum value (as defined in {{bibref|RFC8966}}) to indicate the route was recently retracted and is temporarily unreachable (see {{bibref|RFC8966|Section 3.5.5}}). This metric will be -1 if the route was not received from a neighbor but was generated through other means. At least one of {{param}} and {{param|CalculatedMetric}} MUST have a value other than -1. Having both be other than -1 is expected for a route that is received and subsequently advertised.

parameters.name: CalculatedMetric
parameters.description: A calculated metric for this route. How the metric is calculated is implementation-specific. Maximum value (as defined in {{bibref|RFC8966}}) indicates the route was recently retracted and is temporarily unreachable ({{bibref|RFC8966|Section 3.5.5}}). At least one of {{param|ReceivedMetric}} and {{param}} MUST have a value other than -1. Having both be other than -1 is expected for a route that is received and subsequently advertised.

parameters.name: RouteSeqno
parameters.description: The sequence number with which this route was advertised.

parameters.name: NextHop
parameters.description: The next-hop address of this route. This will be empty if this route has no next-hop address.

parameters.name: RouteFeasible
parameters.description: A Boolean flag indicating whether this route is feasible, as defined in {{bibref|RFC8966|Section 3.5.1}}.

parameters.name: RouteSelected
parameters.description: A Boolean flag indicating whether this route is selected (i.e., whether it is currently being used for forwarding and is being advertised).

object.description: This object provides parameters for routes received from neighbors and internal routes.
